name: DNA topoisomerase II alpha

function.text: TOP2A encodes DNA topoisomerase 2-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in chromatin organization and chromosome segregation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Stomach Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
